description: Built-in workflow step types (HTTP Request, etc.)

input.description: The value to split into batches. Supports {{template}} expressions. A string is split into lines (or on `separator`); a template resolving to a JSON array is grouped directly.
input.title: Input

separator.description: String to split the input on. Supports {{template}} expressions. Defaults to newline splitting when omitted.
separator.title: Separator

size.description: Maximum number of items per batch.
size.title: Batch Size

trim.description: Trim whitespace from each item and drop empty items. Defaults to true.
trim.title: Trim Items

chunk.description: Splits a text (by line) or a list into fixed-size batches, typically for an iterator.
chunk.label: Chunk

message.description: Message to include in the failure. Supports {{template}} expressions.
message.title: Error Message

fail.description: Stops the run and marks it as failed with a message.
fail.label: Fail Workflow

expectedStatus.description: Acceptable HTTP status codes. If empty, any 2xx is accepted.
expectedStatus.title: Expected Status Codes

headers.description: Custom request headers (key-value). Values support {{template}} expressions.
headers.title: Headers

responseFormat.description: How to parse the response. 'json' enables dot-path access in downstream steps.
responseFormat.title: Response Format

http-request.description: Sends an HTTP request and returns the response status and body.
http-request.label: HTTP Request

noop.description: Ends a branch without doing anything, e.g. the path of an if or case that needs no action.
noop.label: End Branch

variables.description: Variables to set, evaluated in order.

name.description: Variable name (letters, digits, underscore; not starting with a digit). Referenced as {{steps.<slug>.result.<name>}}.
name.title: Name

variables.title: Variables

type.description: Type the resolved value is converted to. Defaults to string.
type.title: Type

value.description: Literal value or {{template}} expression. Inside this step, {{steps.<slug>.result.<name>}} refers to the variable's current value. Calculate inside the braces: {{steps.<slug>.result.<name> + 1}}.
value.title: Value

set-variables.description: Computes named values from template expressions for later steps to use.
set-variables.label: Set Variables

payload.description: Payload to pass to the started workflow. Supports {{template}} expressions. Parsed as JSON when possible, otherwise forwarded as a raw string.
payload.title: Payload

workflowName.description: Name of the workflow to start. Supports {{template}} expressions.
workflowName.title: Workflow Name

start-workflow.description: Starts another workflow with an optional payload, without waiting for it to finish.
start-workflow.label: Start Workflow
